scenes.title: MIN
scenes.narration: MIN returns the smallest value in a column, from lowest price to earliest date.

scenes.title: Finding the minimum
bullets: Works on numbers, dates, and text
scenes.narration: MIN scans the column and returns the smallest value it finds. It works not only on numbers but also on dates and text, where smallest means earliest or alphabetically first. NULLs are ignored, so only real values compete for the minimum.

scenes.title: Lowest price per category
scenes.narration: GROUP BY separates products into one group per category. MIN then finds the smallest price within each group. The alias cheapest makes it clear that each row reports that category's lowest price.

scenes.title: How MIN scans
scenes.narration: MIN walks through the non-NULL values in the column. It keeps track of the smallest value it has encountered so far. At the end it returns that minimum, either overall or for each group.

scenes.text: MIN surfaces the smallest value, whether that means the cheapest item or the earliest date.
scenes.narration: Use MIN to find the smallest value in a column, and remember it applies just as naturally to dates and text as to numbers.
